proceedings.supporting_quote: On 16 November 2007 the Commercial Court granted the request and decided to leave the applicant company’s claim and the counterclaim lodged by the LLC unexamined.
On 10 December 2007 a three-judge bench of the Commercial Court rejected the complaint submitted by the applicant company.

proceedings.deciding_body: Arbitration Tribunal of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Armenia
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 7 October 2008 the President of the Arbitration Tribunal informed the applicant company that its request to start arbitration proceedings would not be granted.
On 27 February 2009 the Yerevan Civil Court transferred the case to the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan

proceedings.deciding_body: Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 16 June 2009 the District Court decided to leave the claim lodged by the applicant company unexamined
On 21 July 2009 the Civil Court of Appeal upheld the decision of 16 June 2009.
On 23 September 2009 the Court of Cassation declared the applicant company’s appeal on points of law inadmissible.
